content: localStorage is fully readable by any injected script (XSS = total token theft); OWASP recommends against storing session/refresh tokens there. httpOnly cookies block JS read access (mitigates XSS token theft) but are vulnerable to CSRF unless paired with SameSite + a CSRF defense (synchronizer token, double-submit cookie, or origin/referer checks). Recommended hybrid for SPA+API: short-lived access token kept in memory only (never persisted), refresh token in an httpOnly, Secure, SameSite cookie scoped to the refresh endpoint path.
